title: Anthony Marcar - Clojure At Scale @WalmartLabs
summary: Anthony Marcar describes lessons from three years of using Clojure at WalmartLabs, including scaling a team and a large multi-project codebase in an enterprise setting.
why: HN cites it as evidence of Clojure running real large-scale production systems at Walmart and as a behind-the-scenes talk from that team.

quote.text: For a glimpse behind the scenes, check out a talk we gave at Clojure/West last year.
